svg.text: Upright, neutral turnaround. Body map v1 landmarks. Direction A (Inbox Bot). Hand-drawn Bezier profiles extruded / turned; palette rows only. The stamp arm and antenna sit on opposite sides by design.
18 #8E9BA8 body, head, hopper, hub, stamp block
22 #2B1E16 ink: outline, screen, treads, neck, rubber, hopper inside
12 #FFE8A6 cream: eyes, scan line (13.3:1 on ink)
21 #B23A26 red-ink: TEXT ONLY, 'NOT A FIT' on the CV (flag)
Shade: base x 0.85 (neutral grey multiplier). No other colour.
- Toy machine: soft-cornered boxes, big head,
- Face = the screen: 2 cream pill eyes + a cream
scan line on ink. No mouth anywhere on the face.
- Mouth = the hopper funnel on the head top: from
the game camera you look into a dark oval.
- Stamp arm on the robot's LEFT (one hinge);
antenna on the RIGHT top corner (balance).
- Dark ink treads anchor the mid-grey body on
- Front: screen, plain body. Back: vents + hatch.
treads (fixed; belts and hubs scroll / spin).
MOTION PARTS (pose panels; joins in blue)
SCAN: the line sweeps the screen top to bottom, eyes go flat (reading)
screen = one decal / UV on the head front; the line scrolls in V
STAMP: rest 22 deg, wind-up 150, slam 0 onto the CV ('NOT A FIT')
HOPPER: a CV drops in; the screen starts reading
pose view: yaw 25, pitch 24 (to see into the mouth)
hubs spin + belt scrolls; ball blinks
SCREEN STATES (variants; the body never changes)
eyes low and soft: sorry, NOT A FIT
Voice line beat: 'KEYWORD SYNERGY NOT FOUND' = loading -> notfit (soft, sorry eyes), then the stamp. Never angry eyes.
64 px SILHOUETTE (front, 3/4, game camera; 1x and x3)
LINEUP AT THE GAME CAMERA (x2): ATS estimate on real Ricky v1 grass with Kit, Ricky, 3 Ghosties. Colour, then greyscale (Lena's formula).
